I am sorry for your loss. I will help you talk through a plan. I cannot make legal decisions or move money. I will keep one shared list of concerns in my messages and send the current list to all three of you whenever it changes.

Please send me what you understand the will says about the house, what outcome you need, any money or timing concerns, and any proposal you could support. Please also tell me if you want time to get advice. Until we have a shared view, please pause on signing any sale papers.
